grammar.0.title: Trennbare Verben — separable verbs
grammar.0.text: Some verbs have a small prefix (auf-, an-, ein-, fern-). In a sentence the verb splits: the main part is in second place, the prefix goes to the end. aufstehen → „Ich stehe um sieben Uhr auf.“ The unsplit form appears only in the infinitive (aufstehen).
grammar.1.title: A few separable verbs
grammar.1.note: Rule: the prefix goes to the end, just as the verb does in Bangla — so this is easy for Bangla speakers.
grammar.2.title: The verb is always in second place
grammar.2.text: If you put a time word (dann, danach, um sieben Uhr) at the start of the sentence, the subject moves after the verb, but the verb stays in second place.
quiz.3.why: The main part is in second place, auf goes at the end.
